senses.gloss: f. (חצל, v. חצץ; cmp. מַחֲצֶלֶת, בּיּרְיָא II) matting used for partitions, coverings &c.—Pl חוֹצְלוֹת.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Eduyot 3:4">Eduy. III, 4</cite>; <cite ref="Sukkah 20a:8">Succ. 20ᵃ</cite> <he>כל הח׳ וכ׳</he> all kinds of mattings are liable to uncleanness by contact with corpses; v. <cite ref="M02620"><he>מַרְזוּבְלֵי</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Tosefta Keilim Batra 4:14">Tosef. Kel. B. Bath. IV, 14</cite> <he>החוֹצְלִים</he> ed. Zuck. (Var. <he>חולצות</he>; ed. <he>חוצלות</he>).
